CONSULT NOTE - DENTAL Hospital: Winooski Dental Care Date of service: 03/24/2081 Referring: Dr. Chidinma Eze (Green Mountain Primary Care), referral 3/10/2081 Patient: Theo Marlowe (prev. Tamsin Marlowe-Ruiz in some old records) DOB 07/30/2043 37 yo man
I am seeing this patient for the consultation and report. He come with severe anxiety ("panic", diagnosed 03/09/2081, GAD-7 was 18 at the PCP) and he is afraid of the dentist, so I keep it short. Exam: gingivitis, generalised, calculus subgingival and supragingival. Examination of gingivae done. Scaling both done today, fluoride application. Oral health education. He say he never had cavity, but the PCP letter say dental caries in 2075. He report he brush 3 times, flossing no. Dr. Bogdan Petrescu was the original dentist on the schedule but patient was moved to Dr. Anwar Haddad (me) by scheduling system error, so the template say Petrescu in the top. Please ignore. Patient's grandmother Consuelo Ruiz, ninety-one, accompanied; she asked to stay and was calling him "Tamsin" all time. He did not correct her. I called him Theo as is in the chart. Recommendations: recall 6 months, sedation not needed, relaxation. Payment: ins VTH-5520-1188. Dr. A. Haddad, DDS Page 1 of 1 Last edited by ahaddad on 3/24/2081 16:12 from 192.168.12.40
